glomeris scan — Largest directories under one path, by size.

usage: glomeris scan [path] [top_k]

Read-only — changes nothing.

Walks one directory tree and reports its largest entries. This is the raw size
picture: no evidence correlation, no policy classification, and no notion of
whether anything found is reclaimable — for that, use `detect`. Note the
default path is the current directory, not your whole machine.

Options
  [path]
      Where to start walking. Defaults to the current directory.
  [top_k]
      How many of the largest entries to print. Defaults to 20.
      Positional, so it must follow a path — a lone number is read as a
      path and finds nothing.

Examples
  glomeris scan ~/Library/Developer 30
      What is biggest under one directory?
  glomeris scan
      Same, for the directory you are standing in.

See also: detect, status
